title: ASTRA — Agent-orchestrated Simulation Testbed for Research on Awareness (MCP server, FCS layer)
description: Model Context Protocol server exposing 70 simulation and analysis tools to AI assistants: a LIF+STDP spiking network, a JEPA-style world model, computed proxies named after theories of consciousness, simulated bridges to biocomputing platforms, and an executable layer for the research programme of substrate-constrained functionalism (FCS). All biological and physiological data are simulated; the consciousness-related indices are proxies, not measurements. The vendored directory python/the_consciousness_ai/ and the ported files listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md are not covered by the MIT licence.
notes: Random streams are seeded (ASTRA_SEED, default 20260923; mulberry32). Cite the archived DOI of the release you used.
